Our customers get to consolidate their EDI integration complexity, quickly enable trading partners as self-service and reduce costs.

product.name: Orderful EDI Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform that enables companies to connect once and trade EDI transactions with any partner globally without custom integrations.

product.name: Orderful Network
product.description: A network of pre-connected EDI trading partners allowing users to quickly onboard and trade with thousands of companies through a single platform.

product.name: Orderful API
product.description: An API-driven interface that allows developers to connect supply chain systems to the Orderful platform for sending and receiving EDI transactions.

product.name: Orderful Full-Service EDI Management
product.description: A managed service where Orderful experts handle EDI integration, onboarding, testing, and production monitoring on behalf of clients.

product.description: A solution to automate and validate EDI 856 Advanced Shipping Notices, ensuring accurate and timely shipment information exchange.
